title: The Birdfy Gifts I’d Buy for Backyard Birders
gist: A promotional WIRED gift guide recommending Birdfy smart bird feeders, birdbath and nesting box, highlighting Birdfy's rollout of free lifetime AI bird identification across all feeders, steep holiday discounts (up to about 45–53 percent), and recurring hardware quirks such as Wi-Fi connection problems on its flagship Metal 2 4K.

themes.theme: Free AI ID as competitive lever

insights.claim: Birdfy has rolled out free lifetime AI bird identification with any of its feeders, including the cheapest models, and its app works without an additional subscription.
insights.speaker: Kat Merck
insights.so_what: Giving away AI features that rivals charge subscriptions for pressures subscription-based smart-feeder business models.
insights.locator: Better still, Birdfy just rolled out free lifetime AI ID

insights.claim: Birdfy's AI identification, judged inadequate when WIRED first reviewed the Feeder 1 in 2022, has improved substantially, and the Feeder 1 is now at its lowest price seen, $90 without solar.
insights.speaker: Kat Merck
insights.so_what: Consumer computer-vision features have matured quickly, while hardware prices are falling in the category.
insights.locator: WIRED first reviewed this feeder in 2022

insights.claim: Birdfy's 2026 flagship Metal 2 4K feeder adds 4K resolution, dual-band Wi-Fi and a squirrel-resistant metal body at $200 on sale from $280, but like the previous Feeder 2 Pro it had significant connection issues in WIRED's testing.
insights.speaker: Kat Merck
insights.so_what: Connectivity reliability remains a recurring weakness in Birdfy's premium hardware.
insights.locator: Birdfy's Metal 2 4K is the brand's flagship

insights.claim: Birdfy has expanded beyond feeders into a solar-camera smart birdbath (Bath Pro) and a dual-camera smart nesting box (Nest Duo) with night vision and thermometer and hygrometer, both discounted on Amazon, Birdfy and Walmart for the holidays.
insights.speaker: Kat Merck
insights.so_what: Category expansion around a shared camera-and-app platform broadens Birdfy's addressable market in backyard smart devices.
insights.locator: This interesting product pairs a plastic birdbath
